Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver
1 stated that the vehicle was turning left when it was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding through the
intersection. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee at the scene. The Passenger, seated in the front passenger seat,
was also present, and both the responding officer and independent witnesses confirmed that Driver 1 was isnide the
vehicle at the time of impact. Witness statements, scene photographs, and Driver 2's account all agree with Driver 1's
description of how the crash happened. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with a side impact of the force
described, and the injury reported by Driver 1 is consistent with the kind of contact that would occur in this type of
collision. A few older scratches were noted on the vehicle's rear bumper, which may predate this incident and were
not considered part of the damage from this crash. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle involved.
